Method of Attack: Fileless malware campaign using living-off-the-land binaries (LOLbins) such as WMIC, Bitsadmin, Certutil, Regsvr32 to download, decode, and load malicious DLL payloads in memory
Multi-stage infection process starting with spear-phishing email containing malicious LNK file
Execution of WMIC with /Format parameter to download and execute JavaScript code
JavaScript downloads Base64-encoded payloads decoded by Certutil and loaded via Regsvr32
Reflective loading and injection of DLLs using process hollowing
Stealing sensitive information using key logger, OS calls interception, clipboard monitoring
Exfiltration of data to command-and-control (C2) servers
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing email with malicious link leading to LNK file
